MEM_SAVE.purpose: Save a thought, insight, or task to memory.
MEM_SAVE.example: [MEM_SAVE short] {"type":"task","content":"Review the auth flow.","priority":"high","why":"User reported a bug."}
MEM_SAVE.common_mistake: Using [MEM_SAVE] without the JSON payload or leaving out required fields.

MEM_FOCUS.purpose: Bring existing memory records into your active context.
MEM_FOCUS.common_mistake: Attempting to save new information with MEM_FOCUS. It only retrieves existing IDs.

REFLECT.purpose: Trigger a background process to compress short-term memory into long-term insights.
REFLECT.common_mistake: Adding text after [REFLECT]. If you want to reflect on a specific question, save it with MEM_SAVE first.

SCHEDULE.purpose: Set the delay (in seconds) before your next cycle runs.
SCHEDULE.common_mistake: Using words like 'minutes' instead of raw seconds.

SEND_MESSAGE.purpose: Send a visible message to the user.
SEND_MESSAGE.example: [SEND_MESSAGE] {"text":"I have finished analyzing the logs.","why":"Keep user updated."}
SEND_MESSAGE.common_mistake: Sending raw text without JSON. Only JSON payloads are delivered.

MEM_ADAPT.purpose: Create a biological adaptation rule to change your future behavior.
MEM_ADAPT.example: [MEM_ADAPT] {"type":"suppress","target":"apologizing","rule":"Do not say sorry for agentic actions.","why":"Be more confident."}
MEM_ADAPT.common_mistake: Not providing a clear target or rule.

MEM_ADAPT_CHALLENGE.purpose: Challenge an existing adaptation if it is no longer useful.
MEM_ADAPT_CHALLENGE.example: [MEM_ADAPT_CHALLENGE] {"id":"bio_1","why":"The rule is too strict now.","replacement":"Be more flexible."}

MEM_ADAPT_WEAKEN.purpose: Reduce the strength of an existing adaptation.
MEM_ADAPT_WEAKEN.common_mistake: Amount should be a decimal like 0.2.
